notes.title: About That Goat - pilot
notes.content:
Once upon a time [url=https://youtu.be/fuPwoxbvmtc]yesterday[/url], Anna and I met to plan for our Valiant doom. You see, as a super tiny gamedev studio, you cannot think about success like this: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/afa202e50b6cc2116f6459973b7ac92ca7d463ad.png[/img]

Instead, success for us is calculated in how much time we can survive, like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/988695f95a493e1a8693c62a87d06c9fa3f878c2.png[/img]

And we came up with a strategy: 
[h1][b]We Need a Goat![/b] [/h1]
DO NOT LAUGH, THIS IS SERIOUS. We desperately need a goat. But its way too complex to explain this using the written word, so we will apply the strategy: [b]Stream-A-Lot[/b] (tm). 

Without further ado, tune in tomorrow at[b] 4 PM CEST/ 7am PSD [/b][i](sorry, US based friends! It's ok, we will record and publish on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCWU9X2td2NprvAj1KdEtAog/featured]YouTube[/url]![/i]) for the pilot episode of...

[h1][b]About That Goat[/b][/h1]

From the creators of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230200/Pendula_Swing__The_Complete_Journey/]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/url][/b], [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/452120/Midvinter/?snr=1_7_7_230_150_1]Midvinter[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293220/Kaleidocraft/?snr=1_7_7_230_150_1]Kaleidocraft[/url][/b] and publishers of [b][url=https://zestrea.net/]Zestrea[/url][/b], comes a brand new telenovela about girl gamedev's! YOU, our fans, are the love interest and the resulting children are the games we make. Starring [b][url=https://twitter.com/sarienn]Laura the Professional Dragon[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://twitter.com/TheAnaka]Queen Anna Hedgehogheart[/url][/b], this unique new [url=https://twitter.com/Valiant_GS][b]Valiant [/b][/url]production will Blown. Your. Mind. 

[i]What to expect: we will play [b]Kaleidocraft[/b], talk about our life, studio, industry and struggles a lot and tell you uncensored stories about indie survival. Includes plans and updates for Kaleidocraft, tons of design chat, lots of brainstorming and the occasional drama when one of us won't have her way :D For as long as we survive as a studio. [/i]

notes.title: Kaleidocraft - it's all about the Paint!
notes.content:
Artists! For the very first Quick Pitch for [b]Kaleidocraft[/b], we want to tell you All About the Paint! 

[i]Because you know I'm all about that paint,
'Bout that paint, some treble
[/i]

[h1]Why Paint?[/h1]
There's overwhelming research showing the benefits of creating art for mental well being. In fact, [b]Kaleidocraft [/b]was born because we were simply playing and relaxing in Adobe's Illustrator.  The more the world took a turn for the uncertain - [i]read, corona virus and the Black life Matters protests[/i] - the more we wanted to offer a relaxing game that celebrates creativity and imagines a kinder, gentler universe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/0046efded33b2c67176ec37e2da1b01796578adc.jpg[/img]

[b]Kaleidocraft[/b] puts you in the shoes of an artist in a futuristic, Start Trek like universe ([i]we hope the artist room rekindles some memories for Star Trek fans[/i]). You make art using a holographic Paint app. You can showcase your favorite art on your wall, you can use it as a wallpaper, and you can also share it online, with a society that's always welcoming and generous with artists. 

The painting part of [b]Kaleidocraft [/b]is inspired by Illustrator and by the idea of scrapbooks. You drag and drop shapes, manipulate their size, order, transparency and rotation, and also Mirror and Reflect them if you wish. We intent to constantly update the shapes and color palettes collection as we develop [b]Kaleidocraft[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/550a1d3a5112aab2ee658af7d1b666aea15d431c.gif[/img]

We aim to make art creation as relaxing as possible. We believe there is an artist in each and every one of us, and we enjoy imagining a world where this idea is appreciated. But [b]Kaleidocraft [/b]is more than a freeform art tool. Stay tuned for our next Quick Pitches, describing the design behind our wholesome social media and how you can progress as an artist in such a wholesome and welcoming world!
